tiers.req: Curio system opened in the Act 3 town and all 5 active slots filled.
Daily Fate Spiral bought, for one free chest a day.
A few extra inventory slots bought (21 are needed to hold all 20 curios plus a spare).
100 chests opened and the pity legendary claimed.
Active set matched to what you are doing: crit curios for pushing, defence for offline, woodcutting or mining for gathering.
Active curios at level 50 with their ascension tiers maxed.

tables.title: Curio rules
rows: Each Fate Spiral lets you pick one of three curios. They come from the daily upgrade, chests at 80 gems each (unverified until checked in game), achievements, logins, the Hourglass shop (a Curio for Gold-rift gold, 100 rising x1.3 over 10 purchases, about 4,260 gold) and the paid Curio Pack (an extra daily roll).
Active curios earn coins up to a cap, so collect often. Coins level curios; salvaging unwanted curios gives more.
One duplicate raises a curio's tier by one, adding passives.

Since 0.323.0 you can wish for one Legendary curio: if a Legendary drop misses it, the next Legendary is the wished one. Spare Legendaries trade back for rolls, and chests can auto-open until a chosen rarity drops.
Curio and rune layouts can be saved as presets (six pages each) that switch with your activity. Unlocks at combat level 70.
Curios are an Act 3 system, but their stats apply everywhere.
900 gems, one roll a day for good. Each roll shows three curios and you keep one.
Every roll adds a pity point, and a normal Legendary does not reset them. 100 pity points buy one guaranteed Legendary from the pity chest.
6 ranks, each adding 500 to the cap, cost 450, 550, 650, 750, 850 and 950 gems (4,200 in total). Leave it until the other gem upgrades are bought.
